question: Which of the following has the maximum Vitamin D content?
solution:
The correct answer is **Fish Liver Oil.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• One of the primary components of strong bones is calcium, which vitamin D aids in the body's absorption.
 
• It's** scientific name is Calciferol and it is Fat Soluble Vitamin.**
 
• In **conjunction with calcium, Vitamin D helps guard against Osteoporosis**, a condition that thins and weakens the bones and increases the risk of bone fractures.
 
• Additionally, your body needs vitamin D for other processes. It is necessary for your muscles to contract and for your nerves to transmit signals from your brain to your body.
 
• Vitamin D is necessary for your immune system to fight off foreign viruses and germs.
 
• **The finest natural sources of vitamin D include fatty fish (such as trout, salmon, tuna, and mackerel) and f__ish liver oils.**
 
• **Milk and dairy products are the best sources of calcium. They contain a form of calcium that your body can absorb easily**. Choose yogurts, cheeses, and buttermilk.
 
• Cheese, egg yolks, and beef liver all contain trace levels of vitamin D.
 
• **Mushrooms provide a little vitamin D**. **Some **mushrooms have been **exposed to ultraviolet light to increase their vitamin D content.**
 
• **In children**, **vitamin D deficiency causes rickets**, a disease in which the bones become soft, weak, deformed, and painful.
 
• In **teens and adults, vitamin D deficiency causes Osteomalacia,** a disorder that causes bone pain and muscle weakness.
